blocks.text: New Trends is a multi-asset trading platform built for the next generation of global investors.
We provide access to a broad range of financial markets, including cryptocurrencies, forex, indices, and stocks, helping users explore market opportunities through one streamlined platform.

In a world where financial markets move faster than ever, investors need more than access — they need clarity, efficiency, and a platform designed around real trading behavior. New Trends was created to make multi-asset trading more accessible, intuitive, and responsive to today’s market environment.

Our platform combines market coverage, technology-driven execution, and a user-focused trading experience. Whether users are following major currency pairs, tracking global indices, exploring digital assets, or participating in equity markets, New Trends aims to provide the tools and environment needed to trade with greater confidence.

We believe the future of investing is not limited to a single asset class. Market trends are increasingly connected across crypto, forex, equities, and macro-driven indices. New Trends helps users navigate this connected landscape by bringing multiple markets together in one place.
Our mission is simple: to empower users with smarter access to global markets and help them stay aligned with new trends in modern investing.

At New Trends, we are committed to building a platform that values transparency, usability, and continuous improvement. As markets evolve, we continue to enhance our products, expand market access, and deliver a trading experience designed for both today’s opportunities and tomorrow’s possibilities.
New Trends — trade global markets, follow new opportunities.

New Trends respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and protect information when you access or use our website, trading platform, products, services, and related features.
By using New Trends, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
1. Information We Collect
We may collect personal information that you provide directly to us, information generated through your use of our platform, and information received from third-party service providers.
The types of information we may collect include:
Account InformationSuch as your name, email address, phone number, country or region, account credentials, and communication preferences.

Identity Verification InformationWhere required, we may collect information used for identity verification, compliance, anti-money laundering, fraud prevention, and account security purposes. This may include identification documents, proof of address, date of birth, nationality, and related verification data.
Trading and Transaction InformationSuch as account activity, asset preferences, trading history, order records, deposits, withdrawals, balances, wallet addresses, and related transaction data.
Technical and Device InformationSuch as IP address, browser type, device identifiers, operating system, access time, language settings, referral URLs, log data, and platform usage behavior.
Cookies and Tracking InformationWe may use cookies and similar technologies to improve website performance, remember user preferences, analyze traffic, and enhance the user experience.
2. How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect to operate, maintain, improve, and secure our platform.
This may include using your information to:
Create, verify, and manage your account;
Provide access to trading products, market tools, and platform features;
Process deposits, withdrawals, transactions, and account-related requests;
Conduct identity verification, compliance checks, fraud prevention, and risk management;
Monitor platform security and detect unauthorized activity;
Improve website functionality, user experience, and product performance;
Communicate with you about your account, service updates, security notices, and customer support matters;
Comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and reporting obligations.
3. Cookies and Similar Technologies
We may use cookies, pixels, analytics tools, and similar technologies to understand how users interact with our website and platform.
Cookies may help us:
Keep users signed in;
Remember preferences;
Improve platform performance;
Analyze website traffic;
Detect suspicious activity;
Support security and fraud prevention.
You may adjust your browser settings to refuse or delete cookies. However, some platform features may not function properly without certain cookies.
4. How We Share Information
We do not sell your personal information.
We may share information with trusted third parties only when necessary to operate our services, comply with legal obligations, protect our rights, or maintain platform security.
These third parties may include:
Identity verification and compliance service providers;
Payment, banking, wallet, or transaction service providers;
Cloud hosting, infrastructure, and cybersecurity providers;
Analytics and technical service providers;
Legal, regulatory, law enforcement, or government authorities where required by law;
Professional advisers, including legal, audit, and compliance consultants.
All third-party service providers are expected to handle personal information in accordance with applicable data protection standards.
5. Data Security
We take reasonable technical, administrative, and organizational measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, loss, alteration, or disclosure.
These measures may include encryption, access controls, monitoring systems, secure infrastructure, internal policies, and account protection mechanisms.

However, no method of online transmission or electronic storage is completely secure. Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials and for using strong security practices, including enabling two-factor authentication where available.
6. Data Retention

We retain personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services, maintain business records, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, comply with legal and regulatory obligations, and support security or fraud prevention.
Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information, the purpose of processing, and applicable legal requirements.
When information is no longer required, we may delete, anonymize, or securely store it in accordance with applicable policies and laws.
7. International Data Transfers
As an online trading platform, New Trends may process and store information through service providers located in different countries or regions.

By using our services, you understand that your information may be transferred to, stored in, or processed in jurisdictions outside your country of residence. Where required, we take reasonable steps to ensure that such transfers are handled with appropriate safeguards.
8. Your Rights and Choices
Depending on your location and applicable laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including the right to:
Access the personal information we hold about you;
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information;
Request deletion of certain personal information;
Object to or restrict certain types of processing;
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent;
Request a copy of your personal information;
Manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
To exercise your rights, you may contact us using the contact information provided below. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request.
9. Marketing Communications
We may send you service-related notices, platform updates, product information, or promotional communications where permitted by law.

You may opt out of promotional communications at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions in the message or by contacting us directly. Please note that you may still receive important account, security, legal, or transaction-related messages.
10. Third-Party Links
Our website or platform may contain links to third-party websites, services, tools, or resources.

This Privacy Policy does not apply to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of third parties. We encourage users to review the privacy policies of any third-party services they access.
11. Children’s Privacy
New Trends services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18 or the legal age of majority in their jurisdiction.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we become aware that we have collected information from a minor, we may take steps to delete such information and restrict access to our services.
12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, business practices, legal requirements, or operational needs.
When we update this Privacy Policy, we will revise the “Last Updated” date at the top of this page. Continued use of our services after any update means you acknowledge the revised Privacy Policy.
13. Contact Us
If you have any questions, requests, or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your personal information is handled, please contact us at:
New TrendsEmail: support@newtrendcapital.comWebsite: www.newtrendcapital.com
